notes.title: OUR LITTLE FRIEND: REVAMPED ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h1]OUR LITTLE FRIEND: REVAMPED ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1]

Hey! Long time no see!

I'm here to announce that [b]Our Little Friend[/b] will receive a whole revamp
update! We figured that since it got more attention then we thought, we will do, practically a do over!

It won't take super long, since the game has a base to with!

[h1]WHAT TO EXPECT?[/h1]

[b]Our Little Friend[/b] will have a deeper richer story to unfold and of course, better gameplay elements!
list as follows

[list]
[*] Better Gameplay Elements
[*] Better Story to unfold
[*] Revamped/New EXTRA(s)
[*] Longer Gameplay
[*] Better Design
[*] Revamped/More Achievements
[/list]

[i]and the list goes on[/i]

We are excited to share this with you guys for when it comes out!
But for now

I'll see you guys soon!

notes.title: OUR LITTLE FRIEND | UPDATE #1
notes.content:
Hey! Thanks so much for playing our game!
It means a lot to us! 

Lets get into the update!

This update contains changes and following features that we thought will
improve the game and make it feel more lively!

[b]NEW EXTRA MINIGAME:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added a new extra minigame, when completing all 3 endings!
[/list]

[b]QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added background music when you interact with Ryan
[*] We added subtitles when you talk to Ryan
[/list]

[b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new achievements has been added to the game!
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] We fixed where the bunny can follow you back and stay in after the maze
[*] We fixed where you get 2 endings in 1 ending (hopefully)
[*] Fixed saving errors
[*] Optimized the Game
[/list]

This is all folks!

Keep in mind, this is part 1 of the update!
Part 2 will release shortly.

Thanks for playing the game and hope you continue to enjoy the game!
Make sure to leave a review!
